blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Human Rights (CHR) said on Wednesday that it is looking into alleged violations in connection with the mass arrest of protesters in Manila and Muntinlupa on Nov. 15 during the country’s hosting of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits.
